findings.detail: WA is listed at rank 22 with '1 team' but Washington has Seahawks (NFL), Mariners (MLB), and Kraken (NHL) — at least 3 teams.
List covers 28 states; an inverse 'Fewest major pro sports teams' ranking would be interesting for the many states with zero teams.
Rank 8 lumps 14 states at '1 president' but the trailing '(tied)' labels are applied inconsistently (some entries omit the tag), which is a formatting/labeling inconsistency across identical values.
Every non-zero value uses the '~N laureates' approximate/bucket format (e.g. '~85', '~30'), which prevents precise ranking verification.

Nearly every rank below the top 10 uses suspiciously round numbers (e.g. 700, 620, 600, 580, 560, 540, 500, 490, 480, 470, 450, 430, 410, 400) suggesting fabricated/estimated counts rather than actual IMLS MDF values.

Hawaii is listed at rank 50 with '1 system' — accurate (statewide system) — but Maryland at rank 48 with '20 systems' understates Maryland's 24 public library systems per IMLS 2021 PLS; values below rank 30 look rounded/approximated rather than reported.
Rank 16 GA (10.6%) is above rank 17 RI (14.0%); many later entries also break monotonic descending order (e.g. rank 21 DE 9.9% > rank 20 MN 8.7%, rank 25 NM 9.5% > rank 24 PA 7.4%).
KS (rank 26, 66.8%) and WI (rank 27, 66.8%) have identical values but are given distinct ranks; same for RI (rank 45, 61.4%) and MA (rank 46, 61.4%), and NV (rank 47, 58.9%) and HI (rank 48, 58.9%).
Rank 17 OH (13.4%) and rank 18 MI (13.4%) sit below rank 16 NC (12.8%) despite having higher poverty rates; rank 21 FL 12.9% > rank 20 MO 12.5%; many subsequent inversions between rank 20-45.
OR (rank 16, 36.4%) and RI (rank 17, 36.4%) share the same value but distinct ranks; same issue at MI/IA (rank 34/35, 30.6%) and ID/SC (rank 37/40, 30.3%) and WY/NM (rank 39/41, 29.5%).
Rank 40 SC (30.3%) is placed below rank 39 WY (29.5%), and rank 42 TN (30.1%) is below rank 41 NM (29.5%) — values do not descend monotonically.

Rank 15 MA (13.1%) sits above rank 16 OR (13.9%) and rank 17 WA (13.7%); rank 19 DC 11.5% > rank 20 NE 12.0%; multiple subsequent violations (rank 27 PA 8.8% < rank 28 VA 10.5%, rank 29 NH 4.7% < rank 30 IN 7.9%, rank 41 HI 11.4% far above rank 40 AL 5.4%).
